Name: Funny Merchant
Author: wgdnkns
Description:
[center]### NPC Locations[/center]
[center]Time Location 06:00 ~ 21:00 Beach 06:00 ~ 21:00 Town (Museum area) 12:00 ~ 00:00 Stardrop Saloon[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]He vanishes after 9 PM.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]### Core Mechanics[/center]
[center]🎲 Daily Random Stock Each day, 15 items are refreshed at two locations. The item pool covers almost every valuable item in the game (quest items excluded). Stock changes daily.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]⭐ Random Quality Items have a chance to come in Silver, Gold, or Iridium quality. Higher friendship and daily luck increase the odds of better quality.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]💎 Lucky Discounts Every item rolls its own discount independently. Hover over an item to see the deal:[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Discount Tag Rarity 10~20% off [特惠] 🔥 Ultra Rare 30~40% off [超值] ⭐ Rare 50~60% off [划算] 💎 Common 70~80% off [优惠] 💰 Uncommon 90% off [小惠] 💸 Guaranteed[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]**🔄 Flip for Profit**
Items bought at a discount keep their original value. Buy low at Funny Boy's shop and sell at full price to the shipping bin or Pierre's — especially profitable at deep discounts (1~4). Pair with artisan processing (wine, jelly, etc.) for even bigger margins.

**🧩 Mod Item Support**
The shop's item pool automatically includes items from all installed mods (crops, fish, artisan goods, equipment, etc.) — no extra configuration needed.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Discount odds are influenced by friendship level and daily luck.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]🔒 Purchase Limits[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]- Skill Books (experience books, recipe books, etc.): Limit 1 per day[/center]
[center]- Artifacts (museum donations): Limit 1 per day[/center]
[center]Purchase limits are shared across both shop locations — buy one at the beach and it won't appear at the saloon. A replacement item is added to keep the stock at 15.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]### Installation[/center]
[center]1. Install SMAPI 4.0+[/center]
[center]2. Install Content Patcher 1.30+[/center]
[center]3. Download FunnyMerchant.zip[/center]
[center]4. Extract and place the FunnyMerchant folder into your Mods directory[/center]
[center]5. Launch the game — SMAPI will load it automatically
### Requirements
Mod Min Version SMAPI 4.0.0 Content Patcher 1.30.0
### Compatibility
- ✅ Compatible with UI Info Suite 2 and all UI mods
- ✅ Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and other large content packs
- ✅ Supports mods that add new items — they automatically enter the item pool
- ✅ Safe for existing saves — install or uninstall without issues
- ✅ No save file data written — clean removal
- ❌ NPC requires a new save to appear (CP limitation) — actually works on existing saves too[/center]
